title: Non-crystallographic systems of integers over composition algebras
summary: In this work we revisit classical systems of integers inside the real normed division algebras from the point of view of finite norm shells and root systems. Building on the icosian framework of Moody--Patera and on the integral root-system viewpoint of Chen--Moody--Patera and of Johnson, we isolate the precise axiomatic ingredients of the non-crystallographic analogue: an order over the golden ring \(\Zphi\) together with a distinguished finite root shell whose Cartan coefficients lie in \(\Zphi\).
